# PdfPermissions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Flags enumeration for PDF document permissions. These control what actions users can perform on the encrypted document.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `None`: No permissions granted.
- `Print`: Allow printing the document.
- `Modify`: Allow modifying the document contents.
- `Copy`: Allow copying text and graphics from the document.
- `AnnotateAndFillForms`: Allow adding or modifying annotations and filling form fields.
- `FillForms`: Allow filling in interactive form fields (including signature fields).
- `ExtractForAccessibility`: Allow extracting text and graphics for accessibility purposes.
- `Assemble`: Allow assembling the document (insert, rotate, delete pages, bookmarks).
- `PrintHighQuality`: Allow printing in high quality (when Print is also set).
- `All`: All permissions granted.
